site.name: Richael
site.bio: Year 11 student building GPU kernels, fine-tuned language models, and full-stack applications with real users, with a background in mathematics and modelling competitions.

projects.name: Soulor AI
projects.description: Soulor is a companion app that remembers you. Memory and relationship stage reach generation itself, so a companion's voice shifts across five stages from stranger to soulmate — and the same engine runs simulation modes, for rehearsing a hard conversation before having it for real.

projects.name: VNportal
projects.description: VNportal is a vinyl and music platform built on real-time audio. Find a record, play what sits behind it, then mix it, cut it into a DAW, or play a rhythm game charted from its own detected beats — and generate single instruments, bar-locked to the tempo you set.

aboutCards.title: Year 11 Student
aboutCards.description: Graduating 2028 — IB Math AA HL and NCEA Level 1, planning AP Calculus and Computer Science exams next year — while building AI products on the side.

aboutCards.title: Mathematics & Modelling
aboutCards.description: Honorable Mention at HiMCM and the IMMC regional round, co-authoring modelling papers with a team under competition deadlines. AIME 10/15, AMC 12 Honor Roll (top 5%), and High Distinction in the Australian Mathematics Competition.

aboutCards.title: AI Research & Development
aboutCards.description: Using Claude, VS Code, and Modal to read frontier model papers, write and benchmark GPU kernels, fine-tune and serve language models, and ship web apps.

aboutCards.title: Worldwide Math Community
aboutCards.description: Volunteering in Mustang Math Community in Technology and Curriculum Development, contributing technical skills, creative thinking, and mathematical problem-solving experience.

currentlyLearning.label: Reading
currentlyLearning.title: Kimi K3 technical report
currentlyLearning.detail: At Part 10 of a part-by-part read — through KDA and attention residuals, Stable LatentMoE, and into post-training. Part 11 is on building trustworthy rewards, which runs straight into the research below.

currentlyLearning.label: Building
currentlyLearning.title: Triton GPU kernels
currentlyLearning.detail: One kernel a week, each benchmarked against PyTorch and published with its numbers. Best so far: fused cross-entropy at 15.90 ms against PyTorch's 24.03 ms at vocab 131,072 (1.51x), with 1.67x less peak memory.

currentlyLearning.label: Researching
currentlyLearning.title: RLVR verifier research
currentlyLearning.detail: Leading a five-person paper on when a persistently wrong verifier actually harms GRPO training — holding error rate and asymmetry fixed and sweeping persistence. Targeting COLM / TMLR.
